title: Final Test: Academic Writing Sentence Structure
summary: 30 questions · 30 minutes. Do it alone, without notes, then upload a screenshot of your score to Google Classroom.

blocks.title: Before you start
items: Do the quiz alone, without your notes.
You have 30 minutes. The timer starts when you press Start.
At the end, take a screenshot of your score and upload it to the quiz assignment on Google Classroom.

blocks.title: Final Test: Academic Writing Sentence Structure

questions.q: Which list contains only FANBOYS?
It was very cold, ___ we lit a fire.
The plan sounded perfect, ___ it failed.
He didn't apologise, nor ___ help.
Which sentence is correct?
c: Nada finished early and went home.
Nada finished early and, went home.
Nada, finished early and went home.
Nada finished early, and went home.

questions.q: ___ she was nervous, she answered every question.
You won't improve ___ you practise.
Which is correct?
c: While I was reading, the lights went out.
While, I was reading the lights went out.
While I was reading the lights went out.
The lights went out, while, I was reading.

questions.q: Which is correct?
c: Because he was hungry, he ate.
Because he was hungry. He ate.
He was hungry, because so he ate.
Because he was hungry, so he ate.

questions.q: Neither the players nor the coach ___ satisfied.
Both the museum and the library ___ closed on Fridays.
Which is correct?
c: Not only she sings but also dances.
She sings not only but also dances.
She not only sings but also dances.
She not only sings but also a dancer.

questions.q: Prices went up; ___, fewer people bought cars.
The hotel was cheap; ___, it was very clean.
Which is punctuated correctly?
Which is a comma splice?
c: We were tired, so we slept.
Because we were tired, we slept.

questions.q: Which is a run-on?
c: The bell rang, and we left.
When the bell rang, we left.

questions.q: Which is a fragment?
c: We drove slowly because the road was icy.
The road was icy, so we drove slowly.

questions.q: Which is a phrase?
The book **that I am reading** is exciting. The bold part is …
She said **that the test was easy**. The bold part is …
Ahmed and Ali ran to the shop and bought bread.
The shop was closed, so we went home.
We went home because the shop was closed.
Because the shop was closed, we went home, and we cooked dinner.
Which structure is best for a short, powerful topic sentence?
Which best fixes Exams are stressful, however they are necessary?
c: Exams are stressful; however, they are necessary.
Exams are stressful however they are necessary.
Exams are stressful however, they are necessary.
Exams are stressful, however, they are necessary.

questions.q: Which opening makes a counter-point?
Which is a correct compound-complex sentence?
c: Although it was late the café was open and we ordered tea.
Although it was late, the café was open, we ordered tea.
It was late, the café was open, and we ordered tea.
Although it was late, the café was open, and we ordered tea.
